irregularities.text: Data obtained via owner GitHub mirrors (GEMSDOE/GEMSDOE24 bridges), sha256-verified vs GEMSDOE32 registry/data_manifest.json; not organizer-authenticated.

The prompt reports 0.2778 from the GEMSDOE32 page and 0.3195 as a leaderboard high; these are USER-REPORTED, not submission-page receipts. An earlier dated public-leaderboard pass recorded 0.4413 as an OFFICIAL-LEADERBOARD-OBSERVATION, not a receipt for any artifact; it was not refreshed in this re-audit. The 0.2778 H33 build receipt says UNSCORED. None is a score for the inherited ASB raster.

The inherited local v81.1 comparison and two-draw min/max were not protocol-compliant: no spatial-block-bootstrap 95% CI was supplied, and the H33 reference raster was created with a full-catalogue exclusion that includes heldout labels, making it an invalid hide-and-recover control. The prior receipt also used a private evaluator/writer rather than the pinned shared tools.
Exact lazy-greedy emitter timed out (>1700s); replaced by disclosed batch-greedy in E3 (worse) - shipped emitter is Poisson priority thinning, the E2 winner.

The rejected upload was not supplied, so its range-error cause remains unknown. The inherited candidate passes local finite [0,1] checks, but that does not diagnose the other file or prove organizer acceptance. The shared validator is the current local preflight.

The pinned registry witness has positive support across the footprint. Under the literal finite-positive support rule this gives every nonempty in-footprint dot candidate 100% forward overlap; the pinned shared two_phase_summary classifies the witness as a continuous surface and says its overlap firing is not dot-field duplicate evidence. The protocol does not resolve this meaning. Keep fail-closed; do not claim an interpretation-independent impossibility or silently exempt the witness.

No assigned method paragraph/lane, complete dot-field registry scan, current protocol-compliant HOLDOUT-DTI with spatial-block-bootstrap 95% CI, or organizer-authenticated feature stack is established; no candidate is authorized.
